title: Burning Graph Powers and Branching Trees
summary: Graph burning is a discrete-time process that models the spread of social contagion. Initially, all vertices are unburned. In each round, one unburned vertex is selected and burned, while any unburned vertex that has a burned neighbour from the previous round also becomes burned. The burning number of a graph is the minimum number of rounds needed to burn the entire graph. In this paper, we study the burning number of graph powers.
